# app/vendor/fs

Loose files copied verbatim into the ROM's DragonFS root by build_rom.py
(only when core/filesystem/ does not already have them).

* libdragon_logo.sprite -- the "made with libdragon" splash, an RGBA16
  sprite generated by `mksprite` from core/libdragon/website/logo2.png.
  libdragon is public domain (Unlicense).  Regenerate with:
      cd core && libdragon exec mksprite -f RGBA16 -o filesystem \
                 libdragon/website/logo2.png
      mv core/filesystem/logo2.sprite core/filesystem/libdragon_logo.sprite
